Dungeon Crawl.description: True leads to spot traps, Arrrric is close behind to engage, Suri stays safe in the middle, and the Cleric covers the rear.

Open Road.description: Arrrric scouts out front, True covers the center-left, with spellcasters keeping standard road spacing.

Stealth.description: True creeps far ahead in shadows, Cleric and Suri move quietly in the middle, Arrrric steps softly behind.
